campaignEnvelope.configurationChanges: none in the local shadow; production privacy/blocking/quota changes require exclusive CONFIG_MUTATING or SHARED_SETTING approval
campaignEnvelope.freshNoncePolicy: required; never reuse a historical nonce
campaignEnvelope.manifestDigestPolicy: bind externally after owner inputs, collector and artifact are frozen; do not self-reference
campaignEnvelope.postFixConfirmation: at most one per approved case; saved reference preferred
stopConditions: external Function URI or delivery destination

cases.cleanup: Delete every owned UID through the authorized owner path and verify UID/email absence; preserve uncertain resources in the journal.
cases.comparator: auth-settings-v1 with operation, namespace, response shape, UID/provider state and cleanup binding.
cases.configurationRestorationRule: Save configuration before any mode change; restore the exact projection and verify it before releasing the exclusive lease.
cases.localPreRunControl: Reject fixture transport, caller-supplied localId selection, missing artifact digest and unbound project/tenant.
cases.meaning: Same-provider reauthentication preserves one UID, cross-provider collisions follow documented linking rules, and duplicate-account mode does not merge or delete pre-existing accounts.
cases.observation: Run same-provider, cross-provider, duplicate-mode and explicit link/unlink controls; record status, UID and provider projection.
cases.ownedResources: At most two generated Auth accounts per namespace; no production pre-existing account may be used
cases.postStateReadback: Lookup every involved UID and email index; verify no implicit merge, deletion, UID change or token revocation outside the observed operation.
preflight: mode and expected linking controls frozen
cases.principalTenantDatabase: End-user client credentials plus privileged owner/Admin readback; explicit project and optional tenant
cases.productionOnlyReason: Email ownership, cross-provider collision and mode-transition semantics require backend observation; local linking tests do not establish production parity.
productionOperationSequence: Create two owned accounts with generated identities
Exercise same-provider sign-in and a cross-provider same-email collision control
Exercise explicit duplicate-email mode only if included in the frozen configuration
Read back UID, provider links and email ownership after each outcome
cases.requiredConfiguration: One explicit project/tenant duplicate-email setting; no implicit mode transition during the case
cases.setup: Create only owned generated accounts using the pinned SDK/API path and record the bound UID/resource identifiers.

cases.cleanup: Consume no real delivery; delete owned accounts, verify OOB state according to the approved operation, restore configuration and verify readback.
cases.comparator: auth-settings-v1; classify expected privacy differences separately from transport/ownership failure.
cases.configurationRestorationRule: Exclusive CONFIG_MUTATING lease for any toggle; snapshot, update, readback, restore and post-restore readback are mandatory.
cases.localPreRunControl: Reject a client attempt to use Admin config routes, fixture success without artifact binding and any delivery-enabled setup lacking approval.
cases.meaning: End-user create/delete permissions and email enumeration privacy affect only their documented client paths, while Admin/Owner paths retain their separate authorization.
cases.observation: Exercise privacy, client permission and Admin control paths; record response classification without treating all errors as equivalent.
cases.ownedResources: At most two generated accounts and bounded OOB attempts; no real delivery destination
cases.postStateReadback: Verify rejected signup/delete leaves UID, provider links, tokens, OOB codes, quota success count and timestamps unchanged; verify Admin control separately.
preflight: email/SMS delivery disabled or separately authorized
cases.principalTenantDatabase: End-user ID token/API key and separate owner/Admin principal; explicit project and optional tenant
cases.productionOnlyReason: Email privacy error/provider disclosure and client permission semantics are configuration-dependent backend behavior not established by local tests.
productionOperationSequence: Read project/tenant settings through the authorized management path
Run unknown-email and wrong-password sign-in controls
Run password reset and provider-disclosure controls where approved
Run end-user signup/delete rejection and Admin success controls
Read back user, token, OOB and configuration state after rejection
cases.requiredConfiguration: Explicit permissions/privacy projection; no unapproved settings change in a read-only variant
cases.requirementSurface: client.permissions and emailPrivacyConfig application across sign-in, lookup, reset and self-service operations
cases.setup: Create only owned accounts and capture baseline lookup/token/OOB/configuration state.

cases.cleanup: Delete generated accounts, stop the owned Functions process, close listeners and verify no external URI or secret remains configured.
cases.comparator: auth-settings-v1 with function binding, token-type presence, response/post-state and cleanup evidence.
cases.configurationRestorationRule: Exclusive SHARED_SETTING lease; snapshot the logical selection, restore it and verify the owned route is no longer selected.
cases.localPreRunControl: Reject external or ambiguous URI, fixture transport, wrong project/tenant and any forwarding request that violates the global switch.
cases.meaning: Blocking selection is bound to the owned project/tenant and function, and each forwarded credential requires global, project, function and input-presence authorization.
cases.observation: Record trigger selection, invocation outcome, claim/credential presence metadata and Auth response without persisting token values.
cases.ownedResources: At most one generated account per namespace and one owned local/production Functions endpoint; no external URI
cases.postStateReadback: Verify rejected hook/selector leaves account, token issuance, provider links, pending credential and timestamps unchanged.
preflight: function name/region/URI resolves to an owned daemon route
cases.principalTenantDatabase: End-user principal plus owner-bound Functions/Auth configuration; explicit project and optional tenant
cases.productionOnlyReason: Blocking trigger timing, tenant application and credential forwarding behavior require approved backend/function observation; local function tests are insufficient.
productionOperationSequence: Read the configured blocking projection and function binding
Run an owned signup/sign-in control through the approved blocking function
Exercise one token-forwarding control per approved token type
Exercise wrong-tenant and unauthenticated selector negatives
Read back Auth state and function invocation evidence
cases.requiredConfiguration: Owned Functions route and explicit trigger/token policy; any production setting change requires exclusive approval
cases.requirementSurface: beforeCreate/beforeSignIn selection and inbound ID/access/refresh credential forwarding
cases.setup: Start or bind only the owned Functions endpoint and create a generated account if the selected event requires one.

cases.cleanup: Delete every owned UID and verify absence; do not reset or return quota usage through cleanup; restore any approved temporary setting.
cases.comparator: auth-settings-v1; classify private/undocumented abuse controls as INDETERMINATE rather than mismatch.
cases.configurationRestorationRule: Quota configuration changes require exclusive CONFIG_MUTATING lease; save absolute start/duration, restore and read back; usage state is separate and is not reset by account cleanup.
cases.localPreRunControl: Reject volume beyond the bound, missing logical clock, arbitrary client IP injection, fixture transport and unbound artifact.
cases.meaning: The local fixed-window simulation is deterministic and bounded, while production observation distinguishes documented quota configuration from private abuse controls and does not use a load test.
cases.observation: Record success/rejection, quota diagnostics and post-state; distinguish configuration GET/PATCH from counting behavior.
cases.ownedResources: At most two generated accounts; no high-volume account creation
cases.postStateReadback: Verify failed signup does not create a user, issue a token, consume an OOB code or increment successful-use accounting; verify existing sign-in/link/Admin operations are separate.
preflight: transport peer IP binding; no body/X-Forwarded-For override
cases.principalTenantDatabase: End-user signup principal and owner/Admin cleanup principal; project scoped, tenant is not implicitly split
cases.productionOnlyReason: Official quota counting and abuse controls are not fully public; only a finite, approved observation can establish the selected production boundary.
productionOperationSequence: Read the approved quota configuration and current project state
Run a small below-bound signup control if explicitly approved
Observe one boundary or documented response control without attempting high-volume quota exhaustion
Read back created accounts, tokens and configuration
cases.requiredConfiguration: No production quota mutation in the default candidate; local quotaSimulation uses fixed-window-v1 and a logical clock
cases.requirementSurface: Temporary sign-up quota configuration and deterministic local simulation boundary
cases.setup: Use local logical clock for shadow; for production, use only an approved finite sequence and never assume private abuse-control parity.

comparator.classificationRule: A complete response with a semantic difference is SEMANTIC_MISMATCH; transport, cleanup, ownership, configuration or binding failure is INDETERMINATE.

evidenceBoundary.modelOrDocumentation: not a substitute for runtime or production evidence
